executable_actions.rationale: Prior matching-layer feedback identifies a missing capability: the framework cannot distinguish remote wall-time/cycle-budget termination from a simulator-side failure after the final live record. Obtain explicit bounded authorization only for an unchanged-source replay that needs additional capacity; this is a checker/runner capability repair, not hardware correctness.

observations: The direct current failure is a board verification-capability failure, not an RTL failure: case_axi_ddr_interface rejects the simulation identity binding, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and simulator executable authorization. functional_sim is dependency-blocked because VCS was not run.

The functional-simulation precondition additionally reports that the board testbench artifact loading contract lacks exact_sample_top_module. The exact top, wrapper, and simulator command must be rediscovered and hash-bound from the user-supplied sample project and current Vivado evidence; names must not be guessed or substituted.

The current VCS diagnosis is historical_only because a live source hash changed and its gate binding does not match the current failed gate. The prior nonterminal trace and its possible runner-budget termination are useful only as planning evidence; they do not establish a current board liveness, value, AXI, DDR, ordering, or lower-layer failure.

Operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated lower-layer knowledge. Their certified boundary order and elastic variable-latency overlap semantics remain reusable. No current trace supplies the required direct lower-layer contradiction, so neither layer may be reopened.

SACG truth has 15 active scoped contamination barriers, including barriers .0348-.0352 for the current case_axi_ddr_interface/functional_sim failure. Open retry requests .0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144 remain active and require a Stage7 retry; rejected artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only until that retry passes.

No numeric policy, tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, Transformer-block scope, or board-wrapper source hash may be changed to obtain a pass. Missing board semantic evidence is downstream of the unexecuted VCS run and is not evidence of a semantic-report writer defect.
proposed_actions: Preserve the active SACG trust barriers and retry requests while recording that this candidate plan does not close them.
Regenerate only the board simulation identity/compile/testbench binding from current exact sample-project and Vivado evidence, then rerun case_axi_ddr_interface.
After the static identity gate passes, execute the real VCS board flow with immutable semantic evidence and collect a current terminal trace or explicit termination attribution.
If a replay is nonterminal or budget-truncated, obtain bounded authorization and implement the missing remote termination-disambiguation capability before replaying unchanged hash-bound sources.

If a terminal board failure remains, localize the earliest board causal boundary before proposing any RTL, loader, wrapper, or runtime repair; preserve lower-layer certificates unless the trace directly contradicts one.
risks: Selecting a top module, VCS executable, wrapper, compile order, or Vivado context without cited exact-project evidence would invalidate board-level identity and could silently test a simplified substitute.

A weight manifest or prior lower-layer certificate does not prove board DUT consumption. The board replay must bind complete Transformer-block tensor hashes, deterministic/real stimulus provenance, target-model reference outputs for that same checkpoint and stimulus, frozen tolerance, generated testbench hashes, and complete DUT weight-consumption evidence.

The prior trace's input acceptance and independent AXI/prefetch progress are not output/lifecycle-frontier completion. An unattributed nonterminal run cannot be classified as a kernel deadlock or used to patch RTL.

A terminal board failure can involve model scope, shape, numeric comparison, data order, memory addressing, AXI protocol, runtime lifecycle, implementation integration, or wrapper facts. Repair must localize the earliest current causal boundary before changing any hardware or harness behavior.

Current contamination barriers and open retries prohibit promotion to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, or board runtime even if an individual static artifact is repaired.
